paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: ALP DM decay search with eROSITA eFEDS data, mass range 1.8-18 keV (m_a = 2*E_gamma). Limit on g_agamma from figure 7 (y-axis 1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1). Data points are approximate reads from the exclusion curve since no numerical table is given. Uses NFW profile with local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3, Caggamma=0.75 (DFSZ GUT). Two-photon decay factored. Confidence lowered because values are eyeballed from plot rather than tabulated. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 53)) | Vision: Traced the gold 'eFEDS limit (this work)' line in Figure 7, which forms the lower boundary of the ALP exclusion region. Y-axis is g_agamma in GeV^-1, ranging 1e-19 to 1e-16 (only up to ~1e-17 tick shown clearly). X-axis is m_a in keV converted to eV (1.8-18 keV). The curve is highly oscillatory due to instrument Gaussian lines; sampled densely at peaks/troughs.
